core_obligations: Show the F_i form a Zariski covering of F and that coproduct F_i -> F is representable and surjective (proof lines 1321-1333).
Reduce representability of the diagonal to the representable G_i and glue (proof lines 1336-1346).
Build U -> F as a surjective etale morphism and check etaleness after base change (proof lines 1349-1364).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: an fppf sheaf F on (Sch/S)_{fppf} covered by subfunctors F_i that are algebraic spaces with representable open immersions F_i -> F, whose disjoint union is again an algebraic space and maps surjectively onto F, is an algebraic space (source lines 1298-1318). The proof shows first that the F_i form a Zariski covering, then that the diagonal is representable by reducing to the representable G_i = G x_F F_i and gluing along that Zariski covering, and finally exhibits a surjective etale U = coproduct U_i -> F, checking etaleness after base change to a scheme.
